analysis: The change is documentation-only in docs/reference/configuration.md. The head side edits lines 5-7: it drops "retained-console" from the intro and reassigns console settings to the platform configuration reference. The base side deletes the Console UI section (lines 82-99), which listed NEXT_PUBLIC_* build-time variables and the coordinator URL resolution note. No executable code, key handling, attestation logic, WebSocket protocol, prefix-cache behavior (T-041) or provider configuration semantics change. Removing the console documentation does not alter any control in the retained threat model; console and backend are out of scope per the canonical context. Both units were examined. Unit 3 (base lines 307-485) is unchanged context: App Attest worker opt-ins, add-on hold variables (TB-012, T-059, T-060), logout and endpoint-resumption notes, and engine settings, and it falls outside the changed ranges. The patch excerpt is truncated, but the range map is complete and shows only base ranges [5-7] and [81-99], plus head range [5-7]. One minor integration question: other docs or links may still reference the removed Console UI section or its anchor, such as the console-ui#coordinator-url-resolution link. That is a documentation-drift issue, not a security regression. No threat-model update is needed beyond confirming console ownership has moved to the platform repository.
